scope: Resolve10uncoveredprioritynames from existing official bodies and targeted official support details, plusAERGOreopening andBLZconflict. Generic futures clauses referring to named tokens require explicit paragraph and token binding; spot headline dates are not adopted. BUSD/COIN-M deadlines are not transferred. No performance-based selection.
archive_policy: List exact officialS3prefix before any ZIP fetch; only a small number of actually existing trade archives+checksum are permitted. Existence/nonexistence is evidence about that archive, not proof of global market activity or a relisting event. Do not assume kline/funding records are executed trades.
segment_policy: A launch must be tied to its own contract episode and later terminal schedule. At that episode start reset feature age and lookbacks only; do not splice old-contract prices/funding or reset total-account highwater/inventory automatically. Require completed full daily bars after launch for180-observation eligibility. No short-window substitute.
